title: Kissed Roasted Malaysian Quinoa Bowl
description: A fresh and creamy Malaysian dish featuring quinoa and roast, with a Mediterranean twist, perfect for meal prep. This recipe combines the flavors of Malaysia with the health benefits of quinoa.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, bring the quinoa and water to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry mixture.
Spread the chicken on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables to the baking sheet and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes.
In a small saucepan, heat the coconut milk over low heat.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and stir in the heated coconut milk.
Slice the roasted chicken and vegetables, and serve over the quinoa.
